review: six independent lenses, S1 synthesis, contrarian challenge and bounded repair reviews; parent adjudication

items.issue: Census replacement rejects valid unlinked descriptor
items.resolution: Three bounded close/reopen attempts for zero-link census descriptors; trust checks retained.

items.issue: External same-UID procfs access bypasses private ancestry and cgroup-only write exclusion
items.resolution: Require daemon userns-remap without host override, private mapped work ownership, explicit pinned enforcing AppArmor policy, and global readonly ext4 capture seal. Trusted-root runtime/mapping acceptance pending.

items.issue: Unauthenticated socket peer consumes single broker connection
items.resolution: Unauthorized peers closed inside accept loop; authenticated single-attempt lifecycle retained.

items.issue: Alternating packed/large objects exhaust input reader operation budget
items.resolution: Group final-object consumers and retain the shared object across other chunks; operation limits unchanged.

items.issue: Working source cannot fit configured filesystem but slot already consumed
items.resolution: Conservative image preadmission plus actual work blocks/inodes; host bytes/inodes before slot. File-count-dependent false rejection explicitly documented.
Bounded path-prefix indexes and original component spelling; no all-prior-path scan.

items.issue: Privileged Mac CAS absent from liveness accounting
items.resolution: Fresh root-authenticated nonce/pin census, actual bounded scan, serialized physical occupancy, factory/liveness accounting and unknown fallback.

items.issue: Lost-response UI recovery blocked by new placement eligibility
items.resolution: Authenticated durable-intent listing/recovery/ack independent of placement; original identity only; separate original-request retry for pre-journal failure.

items.issue: Cgroup-v2 alone does not establish kill interface
items.resolution: Actual domain type, writable kill/freeze controls and initial events before launch.

items.issue: Pinned Docker CLI may not support nonrecursive binds
items.resolution: Actual CLI/Engine major>=25 before listen; later daemon/cgroup/security checks retained.

items.issue: Narrowed publish port conflicts with explicit extra properties at caller
items.resolution: Pass actual route directly to narrowed publication ports; local storage remains separate.

items.issue: Multiple current route stops and stale schema/review gate wording
items.resolution: Single current route and current checklist summary; historical stops labeled; schema receipt prose corrected.

items.issue: Conservative file-count estimate rejects some small flat inputs
items.resolution: Document formula and 8192-file/256MiB example; no automatic capacity expansion.
Check host f_favail before slot creation, for all recipes.

items.issue: Seal/containment and early constructor errors lack classified evidence
items.resolution: Intent journal before cgroup setup, fixed operation-failed codes and actual flags; journal creation/IO failure remains best effort.

items.issue: Global AppArmor complain mode not rejected
items.resolution: Require global enforce as well as selected profile enforce; missing field fails closed.

items.issue: Same-page pending submission stranded when failure precedes journal
items.resolution: Explicit unchanged-request retry independent of preview, separate from creation-free existing-intent recovery.
